name: Lola Andrea Beauty
description: Lola Andrea Beauty is a warm, glam beauty studio by Lola Hernandez offering hair color and styling, extensions, lash extensions, and makeup — sun-kissed, effortless beauty that makes you glow.

hero.title: Glow like golden hour.
hero.subtitle: Hair, extensions, lashes, and glam makeup by Lola — sun-kissed beauty that feels as good as it looks. Book your appointment today.

stylists.name: Lola Hernandez
stylists.title: Owner & Beauty Artist
stylists.bio: Lola founded Lola Andrea Beauty to help every client feel confident and glowing. From sun-kissed color and soft curls to full lashes and flawless glam, she creates looks that feel effortless and uniquely you.

reviews.name: Valeria G.
reviews.text: Lola did my hair and makeup for my birthday and I felt like a celebrity. Absolutely flawless!

reviews.name: Jessica R.
reviews.text: My volume lashes are perfect — full but still so light. I won't go to anyone else now.

reviews.name: Daniela M.
reviews.text: Best balayage I've ever had. So natural and sun-kissed. Lola is so sweet and talented.

reviews.name: Brianna S.
reviews.text: She did my bridal hair and makeup and everything lasted all night. Thank you, Lola!
